investigation_notes.Description: A large spike of SharePoint downloads (305 files vs 28 baseline) was observed from acc@globalcorp.ee targeting the Finland HR site at 2026-03-01 15:10 local time (Tampere). The activity used the Mepco MSGraph integration with a WinHttpRequest-style agent, originated from a fixed-line ISP address with a clean reputation, and there are no recent related alerts or events. The accessed files include HR and financial documents which are sensitive, but the combination of integration application context, scripted user-agent, business-hour timing, and benign IP indicators suggests this is likely an authorized automated sync rather than malicious exfiltration.
